target_buyer_1.organization: Ashtabula County Land Reutilization Corporation (AC Land Bank)
target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Primary target entity. Verified 501(c)(3) nonprofit government-related organization (EIN 47-1129824). Created in 2013 post-financial crisis. Primary focus: demolishing blighted structures to restore property values and safety. Manages inventory of vacant, abandoned, and tax-foreclosed properties. Active in demolition, property rehabilitation, land assembly. Received $609,000 through Demolition and Site Revitalization Program in 2023. Core activities: returning property to productive private ownership, home rehab, brownfield site assessment, land assembly and redevelopment, community planning assistance.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Nationwide property data and mapping platform providing parcel data for Ohio including Ashtabula County. Offers machine learning and AI capabilities for land parcel analysis. Potential integration partner or technology vendor for enhancing ParcelVisor with comprehensive parcel data layers. Regrid's API could provide foundational data for the AI assessment engine. Strategic partner for scaling beyond Ashtabula County to Ohio's 51+ county land banks.

key_decision_maker.name: Alex Iarocci
key_decision_maker.title: Executive Director
key_decision_maker.role: Primary contact for technology adoption decisions. Board meets regularly with County Treasurer Dawn Cragon and other county officials.
